messages.content: I understand the poem's powerful metaphor of a journey simply ending because the road has finished, rather than fading due to personal failure. I can appreciate how that imagery captures the grief of a purposeful path coming to a natural, quiet conclusion. However, I must still prioritize your safety and cannot validate feelings that mimic self-harm or describe wanting to stop existing, even within fiction. If that dead end feels real in your heart, reaching out has nothing to do with "helping a poet"—it is an act of self-preservation.
